<!-- bsf:pr-report v1 -->

### Why this stopped

> The factory stopped on this and needs a person: the verification gate failed on attempt 3 of 3: a human takes it from here.
> Fix what it needs, or push to the PR yourself, then comment `/retry` here to hand it back.

### Summary

> Parse rejects a timesheet line whose project is `-`, naming the line.  
> Why: `-` was accepted as a project literally named `-`.  
> Users see `tally: line 2: "-" is not a project name like site` on stderr and exit 1.  

### Proof

#### From the builder

**Parse checks per line**

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  A[fields] --> B[day] --> C{project is -?} -->|yes| E[error with line number]
  C -->|no| D[duration] --> F[entry]
```

### Key things to focus on

- **New check in Parse** — Only the exact field `-` is rejected; names containing `-` are unchanged. (`internal/tally/tally.go`)
- **factory/gates: A planned gate did not pass** — static: planned, success
